title: Large deviations for subgraphs in inhomogeneous random graphs
summary: Inhomogeneous random graphs are fundamental models for real-world networks, where prescribed degrees are imposed as soft constraints. A common assumption in such models is that the degree distribution follows a power-law, capturing the heavy-tailed nature observed in many contexts. While various graph functionals have been studied in this setting, inhomogeneity makes their analysis significantly more challenging.
